items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I’m in the studio and I’ve got this music in front of me it says “She Bangs,” and like I’m the oldest guy in the horn section of the thing

ctx.x: And it didn’t last very long, because business came back. And I think actually I don’t know the whole truth behind the thing but I think maybe what money they withheld, the president of our union said we’ll cut the salary by twenty-five percent. But anyway I don’t want to go there because I wasn’t there so I don’t really under— No I don’t really, © Fillius Jazz Archive -22-
to be totally honest about the thing I’m really occasionally I’ll get, like I’m on Ricky Martin “She Bangs.”
